_doc: Default library blueprints. Characters use the shared character JSON (schema 1) plus race/pronouns/entry. Games stamp copies; edits in a game never change these. User entries live in the browser (localStorage) and can be exported or synced to library/synced/library.json.

entries.name: Thalen Ashvine

custom.catchphrase: {~The roots remember.|The Root keeps count.|Ask the old trees; they saw it.|Rootwarden's word on it.|The forest has a long memory, and so do I.|Every leaf remembers a hand.}

entries.notes: From the combined demo roster.

entries.name: Mara Ironjaw

custom.catchphrase: {~Blood pays for blood.|Steel settles it.|One debt, one blade.|They started it. I'll end it.|Iron remembers what flesh forgets.|Pay me in blood or stay out of my way.}

entries.notes: From the combined demo roster.

entries.name: Bran Holloway

custom.prefix: {~Lost the game.|Well. That's a thing that happened.|Right. Anyway.|Not my best day.|Hm. Noted.|Let's pretend I meant that.}
custom.worried: The turnips won't come in. I can feel it.

entries.notes: From the combined demo roster.

entries.name: Kaelith Vorrun

custom.catchphrase: {~Death is merely a door I hold the key to.|The grave is a rumour I started.|I have buried better men than you, and dug them up again.|Dying is for people without a plan.|Every corpse is a conversation waiting to happen.|The dead are excellent listeners.}
custom.suffix: {~mortal|little one|child of dust|breather|fleeting thing|my dear soon-to-be}

entries.notes: From the combined demo roster.

entries.name: Pip Nine-Fingers

custom.catchphrase: {~Shiny shiny.|Ooh, that's mine now.|Pockets, meet friend.|Is that gold? That's gold.|Finders keepers, losers weepers.|Don't mind me, just counting.}

entries.notes: From the combined demo roster.

entries.name: Durgan Stonebrow
entries.notes: Lingo sample speaker + matching avatar preset.

entries.name: Sela of the Tides

custom.sad: The sea took my sister. It will take me too, one day.

entries.notes: Lingo sample speaker + matching avatar preset.

entries.name: Ember Coalvein

custom.catchphrase: {~Everyone's a liar. Some are just better at it.|Trust is a coin you can only spend once.|I believed someone once. Once.|Smile all you like; I've seen the knife.|Honest men die young. I plan to be old.|Everyone wants something. What's yours?}

entries.notes: Lingo sample speaker + matching avatar preset.

entries.name: The Roadsworn
entries.notes: Four-member starter party for the party-quest prototype.

entries.name: Brannoc Redmane (Warrior)
entries.notes: Frontline Tank. Shield Bash stuns enemies. Whirlwind hits all adjacent foes. Unbreakable when outnumbered.

custom.catchphrase: {~Stay down.|Next.|Is that all?|Come on, then.|I said stay down.}

entries.name: Corvin Hale (Fighter)
entries.notes: Disciplined Duelist. Riposte counters parries. Tactical stances swap between offense and defense. Precise Strike never misses.

custom.catchphrase: {~Form over fury.|Watch the feet.|Again. Properly this time.|Discipline wins.|Measure twice, cut once.}

entries.name: Aurel Dawnward (Paladin)
entries.notes: Holy Warrior. Holy Strike crits vs demons. Lay on Hands keeps allies alive. Consecration sustains long fights.

custom.catchphrase: {~The Light holds.|Stand in the Light.|Not while I stand.|Mercy later.|By the Light, enough.}

entries.name: Wren Ashvale (Ranger)
entries.notes: Precision Ranged. Aimed Shot ignores armor. Rain of Arrows blankets the entire enemy field for 3 rounds.

custom.catchphrase: {~One arrow, one answer.|Quiet now.|Wind's wrong. Wait.|Mark it. Loose.|The trail knows.}

entries.name: Sable Quick (Rogue)
entries.notes: Burst Assassin. 200% Backstab on stunned targets. Death Mark makes enemies take 50% more damage from all sources.

custom.catchphrase: {~Didn't see me. Nobody does.|Blink and it's done.|That was the easy part.|Pockets. Always the pockets.|Quiet feet, quick hands.}

entries.name: Mirelle Sanct (Cleric)
entries.notes: Primary Healer. Mass Resurrection can auto-trigger on wipe. Sanctuary makes an ally temporarily untargetable.

custom.catchphrase: {~Breathe. I have you.|The Light mends.|Hold still, hero.|Not today. Not on my watch.|Wounds close. Grudges don't.}

entries.name: Tamsin Lark (Bard)
entries.notes: Support Maestro. Ballad of Valor gives one hero two turns per round. Song of Ruin strips all enemy buffs at once.

custom.catchphrase: {~Somebody write that down!|And the crowd goes wild.|A verse for that later.|Tragic. Marvellous.|Encore, encore.}

entries.name: Edric Vane (Mage)
entries.notes: AoE Glass Cannon. Fireball torches entire enemy packs. Blizzard hits all enemies for 3 rounds. Arcane Surge: 400% INT.

custom.catchphrase: {~As the theory predicts.|Stand clear.|Elegant, no?|Knowledge is a weapon.|Observe.}

entries.name: Osric Mourne (Necromancer)
entries.notes: Army Builder. Raise Dead turns corpses into skeleton allies. Death Coil applies Poison AND Bleed to all enemies.

custom.catchphrase: {~The dead have opinions.|Rest is optional.|Waste not.|Quiet, all of you.|I could use that body.}

entries.name: Vesna Duskwell (Warlock)
entries.notes: Chaos Dealer. Corruption spreads on enemy death. Soul Pact doubles all DoT at cost of own HP.

custom.catchphrase: {~Everything has a price.|The pact holds.|Louder, please, I want it to hear.|Bargain struck.|You feel that? Good.}

entries.name: Kael Sorrowend (Demon Hunter)
entries.notes: Specialist Killer. +50% damage vs demons. Vengeance stacks from fallen allies then unleashes devastating burst.

custom.catchphrase: {~I smell brimstone.|Send more.|Hell owes me.|Marked. Finished.|Burn it out.}

entries.name: Grit Pennyworth (Scavenger)
entries.notes: Resource Specialist. Lucky Strike inflicts random statuses. Big Score is a high-variance gambling strike — crit huge or whiff.

custom.catchphrase: {~Is that worth anything?|Waste of good boots.|Mine now.|Everything's scrap eventually.|Don't throw that away.}

entries.name: Lucan Farrow (Swashbuckler)
entries.notes: Flashy Duelist. Build Flair stacks with Flourish. Grandeur releases all stacks in one legendary strike.

custom.catchphrase: {~Ha! Did you see that?|Elegance, darling.|Was that all?|Hold my hat.|I make it look easy because it is.}

entries.name: Sera Emberscale (Dragon Knight)
entries.notes: Draconic Warrior. Choose fire/ice/lightning. Draconic Fury turns all attacks into group AoE for 2 rounds.

custom.catchphrase: {~Scale and fire.|The old blood wakes.|Kneel.|I have burned worse.|Roar with me.}

entries.name: Ilsa Cinder (Pyromancer)
entries.notes: Fire Specialist. Stack Burn on multiple groups. Meteor ignites every enemy group simultaneously.

custom.catchphrase: {~Warmer.|Everything burns.|Stand back, friends.|Ash and ember.|Feel that? That's mine.}

entries.name: Torvald Gale (Stormcaller)
entries.notes: Chain Lightning Mage. Chain Lightning jumps between enemies. Thunder Ring zones the battlefield.

custom.catchphrase: {~Hear the thunder?|Lightning picks its own.|Static. Good.|Skies with me.|Crackle.}

entries.name: Aveline Thorne (Druid)
entries.notes: Shapeshifting Healer. Rejuvenation HoTs. Wild Shape for raw damage. Nature’s Wrath in the late game.

custom.catchphrase: {~The wild answers.|Roots and thorns.|Grow. Now.|Nature keeps score.|Hush. Listen.}

entries.name: Nysa Farsight (Oracle)
entries.notes: Predictive Protector. Foresight pre-shields allies against incoming damage. Prophecy reveals enemy intents.

custom.catchphrase: {~I saw this.|Fate turns.|Not yet. Soon.|The thread holds.|You were always going to say that.}

entries.name: Marcus Ostwald (Tactician)
entries.notes: Turn-Order Manipulator. Grants extra actions, repositions allies, reshuffles enemy turn order.

custom.catchphrase: {~As planned.|Hold the line.|Positions.|Predictable.|Adapt.}

entries.name: Benedict Hourne (Chronomancer)
entries.notes: Time Mage. Haste allies, slow enemies, rewind HP, freeze the battlefield in Time Stop.

custom.catchphrase: {~Tick. Tock.|Time is a suggestion.|We have a moment. I made it.|Again, from the top.|Later. Or earlier.}

entries.name: Jiro Stillwater (Monk)
entries.notes: Martial Artist. Unarmed flurries stack chi. Inner Focus self-heals. Shadow Step dashes into crit range.

custom.catchphrase: {~Breathe.|The body knows.|Still water.|Strike. Release.|Enough.}

entries.name: Zuri Bonechant (Shaman)
entries.notes: Spirit Caster. Totems heal over time. Spirit bolts chain to nearby foes. Ancestral Shield wards the party.

custom.catchphrase: {~The spirits watch.|Ancestors, guide the hand.|Old ways, old power.|The bones say yes.|Wind and bone.}

entries.name: Solomon Kreel (Witch Hunter)
entries.notes: Anti-Magic Skirmisher. Silver bolts purge curses. Bonus damage vs demons and undead. Marks targets for the party.

custom.catchphrase: {~Purge it.|Silver settles it.|No mercy for the marked.|Confess.|The hunt ends here.}

entries.name: Isolde Vaunt (Knight)
entries.notes: Sworn Tank. Shield Bash stuns, Taunt locks aggro, Holy Strike sears evil, Rally bolsters the party.

custom.catchphrase: {~For the oath.|Shield up.|Hold fast.|Honour before comfort.|I stand.}

entries.name: Cassius Vell (Sorcerer)
entries.notes: Chaos Caster. Wild Bolt rolls a random element. Arcane Surge doubles spell power. Mana Burn punishes casters.

custom.catchphrase: {~Chaos, kindly.|Ooh, that was new.|Power is a mood.|Let's see what this does.|Marvellous mess.}

entries.name: Dagan Forgehand (Runesmith)
entries.notes: Rune-Forged Bulwark. Rune Hammer hits with imbued force. Wards protect allies. Forge Flame ignites weapons.

custom.catchphrase: {~Forge-marked.|Iron holds.|Struck true.|Runes don't lie.|Hammer says no.}

entries.name: Nyx Veilstep (Shadow Dancer)
entries.notes: Stealth Duelist. Smoke Veil grants evasion. Assassinate executes low-HP foes. Dance of Blades chains strikes.

custom.catchphrase: {~Shadow, take me.|Gone.|Last dance.|Quiet as ash.|You never heard me.}

entries.name: Fenwick Cogsby (Tinker)
entries.notes: Clockwork Mechanist. Clockwork bolts, alchemical grenades, and a pocket-watch that patches wounds mid-fight. Overcharge the whole party with an arcane spring-wound battery.

custom.catchphrase: {~Cogs and gears!|One more adjustment.|Springs wound, bolts loaded.|That should hold. Should.|Science, mostly.}

entries.name: Selene Duskmoon (Priest)
entries.notes: Holy/Shadow Caster. Heals the living, calls back the fallen, and answers their killers with shadow. The party's reviver and second-line damage dealer.

custom.catchphrase: {~Light and shadow both.|Come back to us.|Rest is not the end.|Shadow answers.|Be still.}

entries.name: Auren Whisperlight (Enchanter)
entries.notes: Mind-Magic Controller. Lulls foes to sleep so the party can pick its fights. Drowse opens packs without alerting them. Arcane Jolt wakes targets only when you decide they should die.

custom.catchphrase: {~Sleep now.|Mind over might.|Hush, and dream.|A thought, placed just so.|Wake when I say.}
